mapper.sql: ACT_HI_TASKINSTACT_RU_TASK t LEFT JOIN ACT_HI_PROCINST p ON p.PROC_INST_ID_=t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND p.TENANT_ID_=t.TENANT_ID_ LEFT JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF d ON d.ID_=t.PROC_DEF_ID_ LEFT JOIN bpm_approval_process_ownership o ON o.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(o.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) LEFT JOIN dcc_registration_certificate_bpm_binding rb ON rb.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(rb.bpm_process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND rb.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN dcc_registration_certificate_access_request rr ON rr.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND rr.id=rb.request_id AND CAST(rr.bpm_process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND rr.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN dcc_registration_certificate c ON c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.id=rr.certificate_id AND c.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN dcc_registration_certificate_version cv ON cv.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND cv.id=c.current_version_id AND cv.certificate_id=c.id AND cv.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN dcc_registration_certificate_snapshot cs ON cs.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND cs.id=c.current_snapshot_id AND cs.version_id=cv.id AND cs.deleted=0

rr.id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(rb.business_key AS BINARY)=CAST(p.BUSINESS_KEY_ AS BINARY) AND rb.status='RUNNING' AND rr.status='BPM_BOUND' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bpm_approval_selected_candidate sc WHERE sc.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(sc.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND sc.user_id=#{userId} AND sc.selection_kind='REGISTRATION_CERTIFICATE') AND ((rr.request_type='UPLOAD_CERTIFICATE' AND #{registrationUpload}) OR (rr.request_type='DOWNLOAD_FILE' AND #{registrationDownload}))

choose.when:
AND o.projection_code='DCC_TASK'
AND NOT (d.KEY_ IN ('dcc-controlled-file-upload','dcc-controlled-file-revision') AND t.TASK_DEF_KEY_='DOC_CONTROL_REVIEW' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dcc_controlled_file completed WHERE completed.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(CAST(completed.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND completed.status IN ('ACTIVE','SUPERSEDED','OBSOLETE')))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.ID_) FROM WHERE AND (o.id IS NULL OR p.PROC_INST_ID_ IS NULL OR d.ID_ IS NULL OR CAST(o.process_definition_id AS BINARY) != CAST(t.PROC_DEF_ID_ AS BINARY) OR CAST(o.process_definition_key AS BINARY) != CAST(d.KEY_ AS BINARY) OR NOT (CAST(o.business_key AS BINARY) <=> CAST(p.BUSINESS_KEY_ AS BINARY)) OR d.TENANT_ID_ != #{tenantText} OR (o.authority_type='REGISTRATION_REQUEST' AND (rr.id IS NULL OR CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) != CAST(CAST(rr.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY))) OR (o.authority_type='BUSINESS_REQUEST' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bpm_business_approval_request br WHERE br.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(br.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND CAST(CAST(br.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(br.process_definition_key AS BINARY)=CAST(d.KEY_ AS BINARY) AND CAST(br.object_version AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_version AS BINARY))) OR (o.authority_type='FORM_ACTION' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bpm_form_action_instance f WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(f.bpm_process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND CAST(CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(f.object_version AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_version AS BINARY))) OR (o.authority_type='CONTROLLED_FILE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dcc_controlled_file f WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(f.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND CAST(f.process_definition_key AS BINARY)=CAST(d.KEY_ AS BINARY) AND CAST(f.version_no AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_version AS BINARY))) OR (o.authority_type='OA_LEAVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bpm_oa_leave f WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(f.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY))) OR (o.authority_type='CRM_CONTRACT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_contract f WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(f.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY))) OR (o.authority_type='CRM_RECEIVABLE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_receivable f WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(f.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY))) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcc_registration_certificate_bpm_binding x WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(x.bpm_process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND x.deleted=0)>1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bpm_business_approval_request x WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(x.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY))>1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bpm_form_action_instance x WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND CAST(x.bpm_process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY))>1)
SELECT p.PROC_INST_ID_ ORDER BY p.START_TIME_ DESC,CAST(p.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT c.* ORDER BY c.create_time DESC,CAST(CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY) ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
